summary: Gorax covers the summon strategy and banner priority for the new version banners featuring Anneliesis and Holfast. Anneliesis is a time-limited exclusive and acts as the mandatory core buffer for Aura teams, making her the highest pull priority. Holfast is a massive upgrade over Lincos, replacing even an Inspiration 5 Lincos at Inspiration 0. Players with 300 Heliolite Dice should prioritize Anneliesis, while those with 600 can secure both Anneliesis and Holfast. Gorax also conducts a 600-dice summon session, walking through pity triggers, Inspiration milestones, and upcoming option banners.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Replaces an existing support in Aura teams to drastically boost Talethia and overall team output; Inspiration 3 provides a 30% teamwide damage buff.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Replaces Lincos in Aura compositions even at Inspiration 0 compared to an Inspiration 5 Lincos.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Fully replaced by Holfast in primary Aura teams even when heavily invested at Inspiration 5.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: The central DPS carrying Aura teams whose damage reaches top-tier status when enabled by Anneliesis.

heroes.name: Aemonleyda
heroes.note: Lacks high PvE damage compared to Talethia and is primarily used in PvP.

heroes.name: Journ
heroes.note: Benefits greatly from Inspiration 3, which grants extra Haste that synergizes with his kit.

teams.note: Core Aura boss team (reaching ~700M damage) running Anneliesis as core buffer and Holfast in place of Lincos to support Talethia.

meta_changes: Holfast replaces Lincos in top-tier Aura teams, with Holfast at Inspiration 0 outperforming an Inspiration 5 Lincos.
Anneliesis solidifies Aura as a dominant top-tier PvE archetype alongside Talethia.
tips: If limited to 300 Heliolite Dice, summon Anneliesis first because she is a time-limited exclusive and the core buffer for Aura.
Be mindful of banner durations: Anneliesis's banner lasts 13-14 days, whereas Holfast's selectable banner lasts only 5 days.
Do not pull on the new banners solely for general supports, as the standard support pool in these banners is relatively weak; wait for upcoming option banners to target heroes like Solmo.
Avoid trying to build a second Aura team using Epic heroes, as Epic Aura options lack sufficient damage output.
title: I Pulled on BOTH New Banners… Was It Worth It? | Dragonheir
